 About Mateo Busquets Ferrer
 CountrySpain
 Recorded matches99
 Available seasons2022/2023 – 2026/2027
 Competitions6
 Mateo Busquets Ferrer, born on October 31, 1993 in Palma de Mallorca, is a Spanish referee currently officiating in the Spanish La Liga. His rise in the world of refereeing has been notably rapid. After a single season in the Second Division in 2022-2023, where he officiated 24 games, he was promoted to the top category in the 2023-2024 season. In his first year in La Liga, he officiated 20 matches, showing 109 yellow cards and 7 red cards. One of his most outstanding performances took place in the Madrid derby between Atlético de Madrid and Real Madrid in September 2024. During this match, Busquets Ferrer suspended the game for 15 minutes due to objects being thrown from the stands towards goalkeeper Thibaut Courtois. This decision was widely praise
